READ_STATUS: NOT_APPLICABLE
MISSION: Close the existing architecture gap for selected-guidance attribution and richer hook/format/timing evidence in the variant/A-B workflow without creating a parallel media model or new migration. The supplied source includes the existing content_bundle org/model/captionGuidance/asset/sourceVariant fields, variant_experiment_assignment.reviewBundleId, asset_variant.settings, authenticated bundle and variant routes, generation paths, and dashboard controls.
PROVENANCE_RULE: Never accept a client-supplied arbitrary guidance receipt. An optional source bundle must be selected from an authenticated existing bundle list or supplied as an ID that the server rechecks inside the org/model transaction. Require same org_id, model_id, matching asset or source-variant relationship, supported platform, and a valid server-stored captionGuidance receipt whose caption hash matches the saved variant copy. If no verified source exists, store no attribution and render unavailable.
PERSISTENCE_RULE: Persist only bounded provenance in existing asset_variant.settings JSONB or the existing content_bundle captionGuidance JSONB, using server-derived bundle identity/platform/receipt fingerprint. Do not add a table or migration, do not persist raw captions/provider payloads, and do not expose signed URLs, prompt text, exemplar content or PII.
EVIDENCE_RULE: Extend the existing bounded CaptionGuidanceReceipt only with optional hook type, format, posting hour and timing bucket when those values are already known from an explicit existing source. Do not infer unsupported hook/format/timing values; unknown remains unknown. Preserve edited-caption hash invalidation, observed-versus-selected separation and no-causality wording.
UI_RULE: Make the existing CopyVariantCreate/media and VariantExperimentManager/performance surfaces reachable and truthful: let an operator choose an eligible existing guidance bundle when one exists, show selected guidance/hook/format/timing evidence or unavailable, and never imply that selection proves performance or publication.
PASS_1: Real authenticated route and dashboard callsites must change. Pure contract/helper-only, copied baseline, docs-only or generated output is not delivery.
PASS_2: Tests must cover server provenance rejection for cross-org/model/asset/source-variant and invalid/mismatched caption hash, valid bounded persistence/projection, absent guidance, hook/format/hour bounds, performance attribution and truthful unknown UI state. Exercise real route/component callsites, not only helpers.
PASS_3: Preserve consent, ownership, platform capability, idempotency, replay safety, RLS assumptions and the rule that experiments never publish directly. Manual outcomes remain unverified learning.
PASS_4: Run focused API/worker/dashboard tests, typechecks, builds and lint for changed packages; report exact commands and real exit codes. No live provider or database.
PASS_5: DELIVERY must include exact SOURCE_REF, ARCHIVE_SOURCE/hash, COPY_ROOT, changed paths, per-file SHA-256, behavior-test names/counts and LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE, with explicit confirmation that no deployment, installer, migration execution, database, provider, credential, permission, network, systemd or runtime action occurred.
BLOCK_RULE: If the supplied existing bundle relation cannot safely prove same-org/model/source-variant provenance under these rules, return one terminal BLOCKED naming the exact missing relation. Do not turn that blocker into a helper-only delivery.
CORRECTION_BOUNDARY: One Codex audit only. Do not loop on ACKs, unchanged PROGRESS or repeated helper-only rewrites.
PROTOCOL: Every reply must use strict FT-HERMES/1, correlate with this exact WIRE, include READ_STATUS where required, avoid dates/clocks/timestamps for coordination, and end exactly with:
sincerely, Codex
